function.name: impl_from_IWICBitmapScaler
function.description: This function returns a pointer to a BitmapScaler structure that contains the given IWICBitmapScaler interface pointer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface pointer to an IWICBitmapScaler object.

function.return_type: BitmapScaler *. It represents a pointer to a BitmapScaler structure that contains the given IWICBitmapScaler interface pointer.

function.name: impl_from_IMILBitmapScaler
function.description: This function returns the containing record for the given interface, which is of type BitmapScaler.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface pointer used to get the containing record.

function.return_type: BitmapScaler*. It represents the containing record for the given interface.

function.name: BitmapScaler_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface identifier (iid) matches any of the known interfaces (IUnknown, IWICBitmapSource, IWICBitmapScaler, IMILBitmapScaler). If it does, it assigns the corresponding interface to the output parameter (ppv). If it doesn't, it sets the output parameter to NULL and returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICBitmapScaler interface

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: Reference to the interface identifier to query for

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer that, if the function is successful, points to the requested interface

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function call. S_OK if the function was successful, E_INVALIDARG if ppv is NULL, E_NOINTERFACE if the requested interface is not supported

function.name: BitmapScaler_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the BitmapScaler object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to an IWICBitmapScaler interface.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after increment.

function.name: BitmapScaler_Release
function.description: This function decrements the reference count of the BitmapScaler object. If the reference count becomes zero, it releases the associated resources and frees the memory.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface of a BitmapScaler object.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count of the BitmapScaler object after decrement.

function.name: BitmapScaler_GetSize
function.description: This function retrieves the size of a bitmap scaler object. It checks if the object is initialized and if the width and height pointers are valid. If so, it assigns the object's width and height to the pointers.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the bitmap scaler interface

parameters.name: puiWidth
parameters.description: Pointer to store the width of the bitmap scaler

parameters.name: puiHeight
parameters.description: Pointer to store the height of the bitmap scaler

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_INVALIDARG if the width or height pointer is NULL, and WINCODEC_ERR_NOTINITIALIZED if the bitmap scaler is not initialized

function.name: BitmapScaler_GetPixelFormat
function.description: This function retrieves the pixel format of the bitmap scaler. If the source is not available, it sets the pixel format to GUID_WICPixelFormatDontCare and returns S_OK. Otherwise, it gets the pixel format from the source.

parameters.name: IWICBitmapScaler *iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICBitmapScaler interface that represents the bitmap scaler.

parameters.name: WICPixelFormatGUID *pPixelFormat
parameters.description: Pointer to a WICPixelFormatGUID structure that receives the pixel format of the bitmap scaler.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if successful, E_INVALIDARG if the pPixelFormat parameter is NULL, or the HRESULT value from the IWICBitmapSource_GetPixelFormat method if the source is available.

function.name: BitmapScaler_GetResolution
function.description: This function retrieves the resolution of a bitmap scaler object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface of a bitmap scaler object.

parameters.name: pDpiX
parameters.description: Pointer to a double that receives the horizontal resolution.

parameters.name: pDpiY
parameters.description: Pointer to a double that receives the vertical resolution.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns WINCODEC_ERR_NOTINITIALIZED if the source is not initialized, E_INVALIDARG if pDpiX or pDpiY is NULL, or the result of IWICBitmapSource_GetResolution if successful.

function.name: BitmapScaler_CopyPalette
function.description: This function copies the color palette from the source bitmap to the provided palette object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICBitmapScaler interface

parameters.name: pIPalette
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICPalette interface where the color palette will be copied

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns E_INVALIDARG if the palette pointer is null, WINCODEC_ERR_PALETTEUNAVAILABLE if the source is not available, or the status of the IWICBitmapSource_CopyPalette function call.

function.name: NearestNeighbor_GetRequiredSourceRect
function.description: This function calculates the source rectangle for a bitmap scaler based on the given x and y coordinates.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: Pointer to the BitmapScaler object

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: The x-coordinate

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: The y-coordinate

parameters.name: src_rect
parameters.description: Pointer to the source rectangle to be calculated

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: NearestNeighbor_CopyScanline
function.description: This function copies a scanline from source data to a buffer using the nearest neighbor algorithm.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: Pointer to the BitmapScaler structure

parameters.name: dst_x
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the destination

parameters.name: dst_y
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the destination

parameters.name: dst_width
parameters.description: The width of the destination

parameters.name: src_data
parameters.description: Pointer to the source data

parameters.name: src_data_x
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the source data

parameters.name: src_data_y
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the source data

parameters.name: pbBuffer
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer where the scanline will be copied

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return any value

function.name: BitmapScaler_CopyPixels
function.description: This function copies pixels from a source bitmap to a destination buffer, applying a scaling transformation in the process.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the bitmap scaler.

parameters.name: prc
parameters.description: Pointer to a rectangle structure that specifies the portion of the source bitmap to copy.

parameters.name: cbStride
parameters.description: Specifies the stride, or pitch, of the destination buffer.

parameters.name: cbBufferSize
parameters.description: Specifies the size, in bytes, of the destination buffer.

parameters.name: pbBuffer
parameters.description: Pointer to the destination buffer.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: BitmapScaler_Initialize
function.description: This function initializes a BitmapScaler object. It sets the width, height, and mode of the object, and gets the size and pixel format of the source bitmap. It also sets the source of the BitmapScaler object and the functions to get the required source rectangle and copy the scanline based on the mode.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the BitmapScaler object to be initialized

parameters.name: pISource
parameters.description: Pointer to the source bitmap

parameters.name: uiWidth
parameters.description: The desired width of the BitmapScaler object

parameters.name: uiHeight
parameters.description: The desired height of the BitmapScaler object

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: The interpolation mode to be used for scaling

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: IMILBitmapScaler_QueryInterface
function.description: This function queries an interface of a BitmapScaler object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IMILBitmapScaler interface

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface being queried

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Pointer to the pointer that receives the interface pointer requested in iid

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, success or an error code

function.name: IMILBitmapScaler_AddRef
function.description: This function adds a reference to an IMILBitmapScaler interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IMILBitmapScaler interface.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count of the IMILBitmapScaler interface.

function.name: IMILBitmapScaler_Release
function.description: This function releases the IMILBitmapScaler interface and returns the status of the operation.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the IMILBitmapScaler interface that is to be released.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the status of the operation after releasing the IMILBitmapScaler interface.

function.name: IMILBitmapScaler_GetSize
function.description: This function retrieves the size of a bitmap scaler object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the bitmap scaler interface

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Pointer to store the width of the bitmap scaler

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Pointer to store the height of the bitmap scaler

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, the return value is S_OK. Otherwise, it is an error code.

function.name: IMILBitmapScaler_GetPixelFormat
function.description: This function retrieves the pixel format of a BitmapScaler object. It checks if the BitmapScaler object is initialized and if the format parameter is not null. If these conditions are met, it queries the BitmapScaler's source for the IMILBitmapSource interface and retrieves the pixel format.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the BitmapScaler object whose pixel format is to be retrieved.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: This is a pointer to an integer where the pixel format of the BitmapScaler object will be stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It can return S_OK if the operation was successful, E_INVALIDARG if the format parameter is null, or WINCODEC_ERR_NOTINITIALIZED if the BitmapScaler object is not initialized.

function.name: IMILBitmapScaler_GetResolution
function.description: This function retrieves the resolution of a BitmapScaler object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IMILBitmapScaler interface

parameters.name: dpix
parameters.description: Pointer to a double that receives the horizontal resolution

parameters.name: dpiy
parameters.description: Pointer to a double that receives the vertical resolution

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the method succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: IMILBitmapScaler_CopyPalette
function.description: This function copies the palette from the source to the destination.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the interface of the bitmap scaler.

parameters.name: palette
parameters.description: This is the palette that needs to be copied.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns WINCODEC_ERR_NOTINITIALIZED if the source is not initialized.

function.name: IMILBitmapScaler_CopyPixels
function.description: This function copies pixels from a bitmap scaler interface to a buffer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the bitmap scaler interface

parameters.name: rc
parameters.description: Pointer to the rectangle structure that specifies the portion of the bitmap to copy

parameters.name: stride
parameters.description: Specifies the stride, or pitch, of the bitmap

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Specifies the size of the buffer

parameters.name: buffer
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer that receives the bitmap data

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, the return value is S_OK. If the function fails, it can return an error code.

function.name: IMILBitmapScaler_unknown1
function.description: This function traces the interface and pointer to pointer variables and returns an error code indicating no interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to an IMILBitmapScaler interface.

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a pointer variable.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function call. In this case, it returns E_NOINTERFACE indicating no interface.

function.name: IMILBitmapScaler_Initialize
function.description: This function initializes a BitmapScaler object with a given source, dimensions, and interpolation mode.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the BitmapScaler interface

parameters.name: mil_source
parameters.description: Pointer to the source bitmap

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: The desired width of the scaled bitmap

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: The desired height of the scaled bitmap

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: The interpolation mode to use when scaling the bitmap

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the function succeeds, or an error code if it fails.

function.name: BitmapScaler_Create
function.description: This function creates a BitmapScaler object, initializes its properties, and assigns its address to the provided scaler pointer.

parameters.name: scaler
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to an IWICBitmapScaler object. This function assigns the address of the created BitmapScaler object to this pointer.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, and E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails.
